title: Vacuum clamping fixture for e.g. receiving glass plate at location, has clamping unit whose manually operable release unit is liftable by operation of clamping elements to release suction unit from plugged-in connecting piece

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference discloses a suction gripper with a suction unit and a suction cup defining a vacuum chamber, which implies a seal, but it does not explicitly mention a carrier plate or a seal fastened to it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a vacuum clamping device with a suction gripper and a holder for releasable attachment, which is a form of handling apparatus with a suction plate and a grip unit, but the grip unit is not explicitly described as having all the specified features.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a multi-part plug connection unit where the suction unit is releasably fixable by inserting its attachment piece into a plug-in receptacle.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a tubular attachment piece penetrated by a suction channel that communicates with the suction chamber.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum clamping device with a suction gripper, but not a grip unit for a hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.
The reference describes a clamping unit and a suction unit, but not a housing with a grip portion or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes a vacuum clamping device with a suction unit and a holder, but it does not mention a grip portion or a sound-damping device within it.
This reference does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes a vacuum clamping device but does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
This reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a vacuum clamping device with a suction unit and a holder, but it does not mention a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions or an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

This reference describes a vacuum clamping device, but it does not disclose an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection of exhaust air upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
This reference describes a vacuum clamping device, but it does not mention a grip portion, second housing portion, or bent/curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

This reference describes a vacuum clamping device, but it does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference discloses a vacuum clamping device, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.

(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference discloses a suction gripper with a suction unit and a suction cup, which can be considered a seal, but does not explicitly mention a carrier plate to which the seal is fastened and extends around.
The reference does not disclose a grip unit as described in claim 1 of the subject invention.

(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a vacuum clamping device with a suction unit and a holder for its detachable attachment, which implies a releasable connection between the grip unit (holder) and the suction plate (suction unit).

(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a suction unit with a suction cup defining a vacuum chamber, and a suction channel communicating with this vacuum chamber, which is part of a tubular attachment piece fixed in a holder. This corresponds to a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum clamping device with a releasable suction unit and a holder, which shares some high-level functional similarities with the subject invention, particularly regarding the connection between the suction plate and a grip-like unit.
